title: Narrative practice must be default: agents act on problem and remedy talk unprompted (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
I want to make sure that this information is available by default. It should be something agents manage without me needing to tell them. 

When a conversation begins to describe a problem and remedy... Agents should know what to do with them
